Name: Bahurim
Description: A Benjaminite town on the road from Jerusalem, where Phaltiel followed Michal weeping as far as Bahurim, where Shimei cursed David as he fled, and where Jonathan and Ahimaaz hid in a well.
BiblicalSignificance: Bahurim saw David at his lowest and his return: cursed on the way out, and met again on the way back, with the same road carrying both shame and restoration.
KeyScriptures: 2 Samuel 3:16; 2 Samuel 16:5; 2 Samuel 17:18; 2 Samuel 19:16; 2 Samuel 23:31; 1 Kings 2:8; 1 Chronicles 11:33
RelatedPeople: King David; Shimei, Son of Gera; Michal, Daughter of Saul
